+title: 'Mail step 7 T0: Check the build and list the UI places that assume the old ACPAgent behavior'
+---
+Step 7 of the mail work (mailbox.md section 8 rows 4, 6 and 7; elicitation-plan.md sections 4, 8 and 9, tasks 47 and 48). All items in mailbox.md are decisions.
+
+Current heads (all on main): FoundationModelsACPClient 838bbad, FoundationModelsACPAgent 293be4b, FoundationModelsACP main, Router 77b2da68, Extras 3f18e9e.
+
+New wire behavior of ACPAgent (it also applies to the model of ACPClient, which needed no change):
+- A prompt is mail. The session/prompt response comes at once with its messageId (a ULID). A second prompt while one is open is accepted.
+- running and idle follow the work of the agent, also when no prompt is open (background work, a compaction). An idle has the stop reason of the last prompt that ended since the last running, or NO stop reason when only background work ran. One idle can end the work of two open prompts.
+- ACPAgent never sends requires_action. An open question does not keep the session running (the session can be idle with a pending request).
+- session/cancel: the idle with stop reason cancelled can come later than the prompt response.
+- When the agent ends an open question, it sends $/cancel_request, and ACPClient removes the pending elicitation.
+- /compact returns at once. Its entry (in_progress, then completed or failed) can come after the prompt ended.
+- The end of the work for a prompt is the first idle after the echo of the messageId of its response.
+Other ACP agents also use AgentViewKit. Keep the general behavior (for example the .requiresAction display) for them.
+
+T0 work:
+1. Resolve the packages. Build the library, the tests, the demos and the examples. List each break.
+2. List each place in the UI that assumes the old behavior: a state change only inside a prompt, an idle always with a stop reason, one open prompt, an announcement at each idle, cancel only while running, an entry only inside a prompt.
+3. Report each gap before you change code for it.
+
+Rules: all text in STE. Commit after each task with AgentViewKit green. Run the full suite one time. A test that fails only sometimes is a bad test: find the cause. No .timeLimit, sleep, clock wait, poll or retry. Delete no test without a decision. #mail-step-7
\ No newline at end of file
